work.title: Unresolved Evidence to Draft Work Product to Release Block
authority: Direct user instruction: freeze REDWOOD-GOV-001 as a distinct governance proof
Project Redwood non-negotiable invariant: unreconciled differences must be surfaced and never silently forced to balance

intent.productGoal: Produce a traceable Quality of Revenue draft work product from source evidence without converting unresolved differences into a clean client-release result.
intent.capability: Carry an unresolved reconciliation finding through deterministic calculation, professional review, and draft workbook availability while release remains blocked.
architecturalIntent: Calculation completeness at G4 is distinct from reconciliation, professional review, and client-release authority.
G1 source sufficiency/quarantine and G2 mapping review are distinct gate responsibilities.
A run and its source-artifact hashes bind evidence claims; corpus letters are not durable semantic identities.
invariants: The A/R difference remains visible and is not force-balanced or suppressed.
No client-release status is implied while prerequisite gates are not passed.
Provider-departure source evidence is not misrepresented as a completed sustainability-analysis proof.
acceptanceEvidence: Persisted Challenge D browser run c8f21c7f-82a5-47a1-9d21-ab78af14660a.
Source artifact inventory and hashes recorded in docs/SCENARIO_IDENTITY_REGISTRY.md.
Captured browser screenshots show Map, Reconcile, Review, and Export states.

decisions.decision: Register REDWOOD-GOV-001 separately from provider-departure sustainability work.
decisions.rationale: The observed run proves governance and release behavior; source semantics alone do not prove a visible end-to-end sustainability result.

decisions.decision: Record the exact G1 quarantine reason separately from G2 mapping status.
decisions.rationale: This preserves the intended gate boundary and prevents unreviewed mappings from being misreported as a source-sufficiency failure.

observedBehaviour: The run retained a $4,539.31 A/R snapshot-to-GL A/R difference as one open reconciliation finding with professional materiality unset.
G4 passed while G0, G1, G2, G3, G5, G6, and G7 were not passed; G7 cited those prerequisite gates and denied client release.
A draft workbook download was available and the Export view explicitly stated that client release was blocked.
G1 was blocked by one quarantined adjustment row with reason Missing adjustment amount; G2 was independently blocked by mapping state.
The source package contains a provider departure for PRV-004, but the captured Analyze UI did not display provider sustainability output.

evidence.result: Persisted run records the gate states, quarantine record, finding, source inventory, mappings, and source content; all seven archive-entry hashes exactly match the complete run inventory and no archive-only entry exists.
Semantic identity binding, exact source hashes, G1 cause, and provider-departure evidence are recorded.

evidence.reference: Challenge D browser screenshots supplied in the session
evidence.result: Map, Reconcile, Review, and Export views show the unresolved finding, draft download affordance, and explicit client-release block.

divergences.expected: The G1 presentation should communicate the same gate semantics from intake through the persisted run.
divergences.observed: The Map page showed an intake-stage G1 pass_with_warnings based on required-source presence, while the persisted run's G1 was blocked because one adjustment row was quarantined.

divergences.expected: A provider-departure sustainability proof visibly demonstrates the run-bound sustainability output.
divergences.observed: Challenge D contains provider departure source evidence, but the captured Analyze UI exposes provider concentration rather than providerSustainability output.

learning.recurringPattern: Lettered corpus labels can be mistaken for semantic test identities, causing governance proofs and business-capability proofs to be conflated.
learning.improvementProposal: Require semantic scenario IDs, exact run bindings, and source hashes in scenario evidence before a proof claim can be marked proven.
durableKnowledge: Challenge D is an eligible source corpus for RS-PROVIDER-DEPARTURE-001 because it contains PRV-004 departure evidence.
Eligibility of source semantics is not proof of an end-to-end user-visible analysis capability.
